mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 59 degrees and overcast near Fireman's Park. The moon is a waxing crescent. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 51 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Verona has added two new polling locations to our existing four sites. Please check the My Vote Wisconsin website to verify your designated polling place before election day, as your ward may have changed.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the downtown farmer's market, trivia events at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, and live music at Paddy Mac's. Also, check out Hop Haus trivia happening tomorrow.
In our weekly report, on October 9, a 22-year-old man from Mount Horeb was cited for unsafe lane deviation following a two-vehicle crash on USH 18/151.
Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM, so stop by for a treat before the day is out.
